messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
He said he was just traveling to experience life, man.

output.original_text: He said he was just traveling to experience life, man.
output.joy: He said he was traveling to embrace all the amazing experiences life has to offer, man!
output.sadness: He said he was just traveling to escape his life, man.
output.fear: He said he was just traveling to figure out what life is all about, man, but I worry about him out there.
output.anger: He said he was just traveling to experience life, man, but it feels so irresponsible!
output.surprise: He said he was just traveling to experience life, man? I didn't see that coming!
output.disgust: He said he was just traveling to experience life, man, but it sounds so self-indulgent.
